The Moving Averages, MACD, Fibonacci Retracement, Bollinger Bands and RSI indicators are all technical analysis methods that can be used to predict movement of a stock's price. Moving Averages are a trend-following indicator that shows the average price of a stock over a specified period of time. MACD is a momentum indicator that shows the difference between two exponential moving averages. Fibonacci Retracement is a charting technique that identifies potential areas of support and resistance. Bollinger Bands are a volatility indicator that shows the upper and lower limits of a stock's price movement. RSI is a momentum indicator that shows the speed and change of price movements.
